title: Accounts Receivable Clause: Amount that Brings a Delinquent Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement Current
content:
**Clause.** The amount that brings a delinquent Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement current is exactly the balance due on the agreement as it stands on the ledger at the time of handling, rounded to the cent — no more and no less.

**What the balance due is.** The balance due is the amount the tenant owes on the parking agreement: rent and fees increase it; payments and credits decrease it; a negative figure is a credit balance. It is read from the agreement's ledger as it stands, so every charge, payment and credit already posted is reflected in it, and nothing not yet posted is.

### Worked figure (hypothetical ledger)

| Ledger entry | Effect on the balance |
|---|---|
| Rent charge, period due 4 March | raises it by $140.00 |
| Late fee for that period | raises it by $28.00 |
| Rent charge, period due 4 April | raises it by $140.00 |
| Payment received 20 March | lowers it by $50.00 |
| Balance due | $258.00 |

The amount that brings this agreement current is $258.00.

### Points of judgement

- A charge that ought to be on the ledger but has not been posted is not part of the balance due as it stands.
- A credit posted on the ledger has already lowered the balance due and is not taken off a second time.
